project.title: Unified Sales and Contact Centre Playbook Rollout
project.objective: Design and roll out a unified playbook to standardise sales and contact centre processes, improve customer experience, and increase conversion rates.
deliverables: Unified sales and contact centre process playbook
Standardised call and email scripts for key customer journeys
Training plan and schedule for all agents
Pilot rollout report with KPIs and improvement actions
constraints: Playbook must align with existing company policies and consumer protection law
No changes to core CRM platform in this phase, only configuration and usage guidelines
Pilot must be completed within one month of project start
Training sessions must fit within current shift schedules
Reporting must use existing data fields and structures

risks.risk: Agents resist new scripts and processes, leading to inconsistent adoption.
risks.mitigation: Involve supervisors and top-performing agents in design, run pilot, collect feedback, and adjust before full rollout.

risks.risk: Playbook conflicts with existing compliance or consumer protection requirements.
risks.mitigation: Early review with compliance officer and legal, and sign-off required before training rollout.

risks.risk: Reporting requirements exceed what current CRM can support.
risks.mitigation: Limit dashboard requirements to existing fields, validate feasibility with CRM admin before finalising.

risks.risk: Operational KPIs temporarily dip during transition to new processes.
risks.mitigation: Stagger rollout by team, monitor KPIs weekly, and provide targeted coaching where performance drops.

themes.why_relevant: Ensures consistent experience across sales and contact centre, reducing errors and confusion.
Uses existing reports and dashboards to track impact on sales, service levels, and quality.
Scripts and processes must respect legal and company policy constraints in all interactions.
Sales account managers and contact centre supervisors must align on handovers and responsibilities.
Smooth adoption depends on clear training, coaching, and feedback loops with frontline staff.

backlog.task: Map current end-to-end customer journeys for inbound and outbound interactions
definition_of_done: Key customer journeys documented for inbound, outbound, and follow-up
Pain points and inconsistencies highlighted
Validated with at least one sales account manager

backlog.task: Define standard qualification and needs analysis checklist for sales opportunities
definition_of_done: Checklist drafted covering key qualification questions and data points
Reviewed by contact centre supervisors for practicality
Approved by sales operations manager

backlog.task: Draft unified call scripts for top 5 contact reasons
definition_of_done: Scripts created for top 5 contact reasons based on volume data
Compliance officer reviews and signs off
Pilot group of agents provides feedback

backlog.task: Create email and chat templates aligned with new playbook
definition_of_done: Templates created for key stages: introduction, follow-up, closing, and escalation
Templates tested in at least 10 real cases
Templates stored in shared repository and communicated to teams

backlog.task: Define CRM usage guidelines and mandatory fields for each interaction type
definition_of_done: List of mandatory fields per interaction type documented
Guidelines aligned with existing CRM configuration
Guidelines validated with sales account managers

backlog.task: Specify performance dashboard metrics and reporting cadence
definition_of_done: Core KPIs defined for sales and service performance
Data sources confirmed as available in current CRM
Reporting cadence agreed with stakeholders

backlog.task: Design training plan and schedule for agents and account managers
definition_of_done: Training objectives and agenda defined
Sessions scheduled across shifts with minimal service impact
Training materials linked to playbook and scripts

backlog.task: Run pilot of new playbook with one sales pod and one contact centre team
definition_of_done: Pilot scope and duration agreed
Baseline KPIs captured before pilot
Pilot results documented with recommendations

backlog.task: Consolidate unified sales and contact centre playbook document
definition_of_done: All approved processes, scripts, and templates included
Version control and ownership defined
Shared with all stakeholders in central repository

backlog.task: Define escalation paths between contact centre and sales for high-value leads
definition_of_done: Clear criteria for high-value leads documented
Escalation steps and SLAs agreed with supervisors
Process added to playbook and communicated to teams

backlog.task: Create quality monitoring checklist aligned with new scripts
definition_of_done: Checklist items mapped to key behaviours and compliance points
Tested on sample of recorded calls
Approved by customer service manager

backlog.task: Prepare communication plan for full rollout
definition_of_done: Key messages, timelines, and channels defined
Stakeholder impact assessed
Plan reviewed with contact centre supervisors

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope, success metrics, and initial task ownership for the playbook project.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the unified playbook initiative and asking for confirmation on scope and KPIs.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on final list of project KPIs and success criteria for the pilot.
Confirm ownership for each backlog task T1–T4 and initial deadlines.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review and finalise scripts, qualification checklist, and CRM guidelines.
threads_plan.trigger: Post draft versions of scripts, qualification checklist, and CRM guide for async review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the sales qualification checklist for use in the pilot.
Sign off on the initial set of call, email, and chat scripts.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock in training approach, schedule, and quality monitoring process.
threads_plan.trigger: Share draft training plan and quality checklist and request feedback on feasibility.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on final training schedule and format for agents and account managers.
Approve the quality monitoring checklist and review cadence.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan and monitor the pilot rollout, including escalation paths and dashboards.
threads_plan.trigger: Announcement that pilot teams have been selected and need clarity on process and reporting.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm pilot scope, duration, and participating teams.
Agree on escalation criteria and SLAs for high-value leads during the pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Consolidate learnings from pilot and confirm go-live plan for full rollout.
threads_plan.trigger: Pilot completion update with preliminary KPI results shared in the channel.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Reconfirm that pilot KPIs meet the agreed success criteria for full rollout.

channel_rituals: Daily async standup where each participant posts yesterday/today/blockers in one thread.
Weekly KPI check-in summarising key metrics from the pilot and rollout progress.
Script and playbook review session every two weeks to capture frontline feedback.
Post-training feedback thread after each training wave to collect quick reactions.
End-of-pilot retrospective thread to list what worked, what did not, and next actions.
